name: warehouse-test2-preview
description: Preview-ready Digital Warehouse Automation unit (separate from existing production folder).

scripts.ci:check-deploy-secrets: node -e "if (!process.env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN || !process.env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID) { console.error('Missing CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.db:status: npx wrangler@3 d1 execute warehouse-preview-db --local --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';"
scripts.smoke:api: node -e "(async()=>{const base=process.env.WORKER_BASE_URL||'http://127.0.0.1:8787';const headers={'x-user-email':'admin@demo.local'};const health=await(await fetch(`${base}/api/health`)).json();if(!health?.ok){console.error('Health check failed',health);process.exit(1);}const inventory=await(await fetch(`${base}/api/inventory`,{headers})).json();if(!inventory||!Array.isArray(inventory.inventory)){console.error('Inventory payload invalid',inventory);process.exit(1);}console.log('Smoke check OK',inventory.inventory.length);})()"
